claims.claim_ar: حرف الفاء في «فَإِنَّ» هنا وظيفة استئنافية (وصلية/فاصلة) تربط الجملة بما قبلها وتُبيّن نتيجة أو استئنافًا للمقصود.
claims.claim_en: The prefixed fa in «فَإِنَّ» functions as an istināf (resumptive/connecting) particle linking this clause to what precedes it and indicating a resultant or resumptive relation.
claims.rhetorical_effect: marks consequence/continuation; highlights the result (the divine sufficiency) after the conditional/contrast

claims.claim_ar: تكرار المرادف في «آيَاتٌ بَيِّنَاتٌ» (تكديس المرادف) وظيفة بلاغية للتوكيد والإظهار: إيضاح أن الآيات واضحة وجلية.
claims.claim_en: The repetition/near-synonym in «آيَاتٌ بَيِّنَاتٌ» (stacking of synonyms) serves as rhetorical repetition to emphasize and make explicit that the signs are clear.
claims.needs_review_reason: The cited source passage discusses the rhetorical function of repetition generally but does not quote this specific phrase from the verse; inference from general principle.
claims.rhetorical_effect: intensifies and clarifies the meaning (emphatic clarification)
